field_acl_comment: Read-path field ACL. Per instance ('default' = default instance), per model, exactly one of 'deny' (blacklist) or 'allow' (exclusive whitelist). '*' is a per-instance model wildcard. 2026-08-25, Dalton's decision: commercial masking removed. margin, purchase_price, standard_price and partner credit/balance are readable — Purchasing and Accounting need them, and a read-only connection is a reasonable place to get them. What remains is not commercial. hr.employee uses 'allow' deliberately: an exclusive whitelist is strictly stricter than enumerating PII to deny, and it stays safe when Odoo adds new sensitive fields on upgrade. hr.version (Odoo 19 contract/wage model) keeps an explicit deny list because it has no small readable subset. res.partner.bank hides account numbers. res.users.apikeys uses 'allow' for the same upgrade-safety reason: Odoo 19 exposes no key or key-prefix field on that model, so this closes no present hole, but it guarantees a future Odoo that adds one cannot surface it through search_records, the knowledge indexer, or odoo:// resources. Those four stay masked because every current holder of this connection carries Odoo's Employees/Administrator and Payroll/Officer groups, so Odoo itself would not refuse a payroll read — this file is the only control until SERVICE-USERS.md is applied. Change only via PR.
